notes.title: Mass Exodus Online Multiplayer / Remote Play
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Mass Exodus is fully compatible with Steam Remote Play. Having the ability to play the game online in the current circumstances is a real plus, we hope you enjoy! 

Setting up a Remote Play game is simple. Whoever hosts has to be the seeker (VR) and they can invite up to 4 PC players. The only restriction is 1 of these players can use a keyboard and mouse, the others need to be on game controllers. 

More info on setting up a Remote Play game is here https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay?snr=1_7_7_230


As Steam said “Launch the game, invite friends and BOOM you’re playing together”

Enlight of this we will not be developing an online multiplayer version of Mass Exodus at the moment. 

Let us know how you get on with Remote Play, we have found it really stable.

notes.title: Mass Exodus Redux v2.0
notes.notes:
[b]It’s been a long time coming, but we are excited to announce that Mass Exodus Redux is now live!  

This is the biggest update to the game ever, completely rebuilt from the ground up, including new features, bug fixes, a new map and all-new visuals.   

We hope that you enjoy playing the new version, let us know if there’s anything we missed and please leave a review if you like what you see!  [/b]


[b][h1]Visuals[/h1][/b][list] 
[*]New VR Hand models with poses 
[*]New powerup visuals for both players 
[*]New UI for both players 
[*]New and improved main menu 
[*]New Post Processing effects in all areas 
[*]New lighting in all levels 
[*]New particle effects in all levels 
[*]Added visual for players to see other players through walls during local multiplayer 
[*]Added visual for players to see active control panels through walls 

[/list] 

[b][h1]Gameplay[/h1][/b][list] 
[*]Added a brand-new level “Level 4” 
[*]Added Seeker death sequence 
[*]Added win screen for both players 
[*]Added full controller support 
[*]Added ability to rematch with current settings 
[*]Added a playable tutorial for both players 
[*]New AI system with avoidance for other robots and players 
[*]Removed Mini-Map as it was making PC play a touch too easy 
[/list] 

[b][h1]Sound[/h1][/b][list] 
[*]Added voice lines for VR Player 
[*]Added additional track layering to all levels to increase gameplay tension 
[*]New music for Level 4 and Main Menu 
[/list] 

[b][h1]Optimizations[/h1][/b][list] 
[*]Brand new render pipeline for better visuals and faster calculations. 
[*]Many back-end improvements to vastly improve performance in all areas. 
[*]All game-logic re-programmed from the ground up, to improve game flow and use more efficient techniques. 

[/list] 

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b][list] 
[*]Everything has been re-programmed and re-built from the ground up meaning old bugs and performance problems are now non-existent. We have extensively tested our end for any remaining issues we have identified, although there may still be a few things that we plan to quickly resolve. Let us know if you find anything!  

[/list]

notes.title: Mass Exodus v1.2 Patch Notes - The Rework
notes.notes:
The overhaul of the game is finally done, and should fix almost every issue people have had with the game
 
We’re sorry it took so long but it’s worth it! 
 
Here’s a quick summary of some of the bigger things that have changed, amongst others that didn't make the list!
 
[b][h1]New![/h1][/b][list]
[*]New VR area for Main menu and lobby
[*]Post processing effects for the Seeker to make the game much prettier!
[*]Blind has been changed to distort, it no longer removes vision from the Seeker but makes it much harder to see
[*]Pickup sphere for the right hand to make picking up androids much more accurate
[*]Win / Lose screen unique for both players, as well as options to retry or quit the game
[*]Ready up screen for the PC player has an extra step to show what inputs everyone is using and to confirm they’re working
[*]More options for level customisation
[*]Sensitivity for Mouse and Controllers can now be adjusted in game
[*]A brightness slider has been added to the options menu
[*]New loading screen
[*]Teleporters now have icons on the mini-map
[/list]
 
[b][h1]Reworked![/h1][/b][list]
[*]Completely new AI system which is smarter, quicker and better on performance
[*]Mini-map has received a beautiful new look - which shows less of the map to stop players from just watching the seekers head
[*]All animations have been updated for the rogue and androids
[*]Seeker’s handheld remote (left hand) has new UI to show more accurate information
[*]Lighting and effects have all received visual updates
[*]Teleporters on The Core have received a new particle effect and transition animation
[*]UI additions have been made to give the player guidance such as how many panels are left to turn off
[*]Freeze AI has been adjusted so that all robots randomly stop within 0.5 seconds to allow the rogue time to react
[*]Invisibility has received a new visual effect
[/list]

[h1]Please check our other post for information on online changes.[/h1]

Thankyou! 
The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes, purchase problems and performance.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Thank you yet again for your continued support with Mass Exodus, today there's a couple of things that we want to talk about.

[h1]The Game[/h1]

We understand that there are some glaring issues with the most recent patch, as well as some underlying issues that we want to fix quickly.

Due to the way the game was made (through a game jam), the base code is not in a stable state to keep updating, so we're rebuilding it from the ground up. This will improve performance amongst other things, [b]drastically[/b].

We aim to have this finished within the next week or two, and hopefully this will resolve almost all of the issues people have been having with the game.

[h1]VR client and PC client[/h1]

We've found since launching the PC client of the game, theres some big issues that stop you from upgrading to the VR version, or gifting either versions to a friend. 

Currently the game has 2 app IDs, but your Steam library only checks to see you have one. So it almost merges them if you upgrade, causing big issues.

We're talking to some of the Steam / Valve team at the moment, on making it so the game is easier to purchase and understand, the new system will hopefully be as follows:[list]

[*]VR Client will be removed from the Store

[*]PC Client will remain as it is

[*]DLC to upgrade unlock VR features (This will be given to everyone who originally owned the VR version of the game)[/list]

Hopefully this will resolve all issues people have been having with the game, purchasing, and even playing without issues.

We'll post here once the game updated. 

Thank you
The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Thanks for your feedback, here's what's coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We hope you're enjoying the newest update from Mass Exodus, and we really appreciate all the feedback we've had from it. 

We understand that there are some core issues for several players, and we obviously need to fix them as soon as we can. 

Due to the nature of which the game was made - starting as a game jam, then converting to online multiplayer etc - we've found that a large portion of the game needs replacing to make updates and fixes much easier to push. 

[h1]We're currently revamping the majority of the game, including the following:[/h1][list]
    [*]New Menu Interface for VR and PC
    [*]Better Multiplayer systems
    [*]Much better performance for all users
[*]Reworked AI for androids
[/list]
Here at Polymerse we want the best product possible, so spending a little time to make Mass Exodus the best game it can be is our top priority. 

The new update will be pushed in the coming weeks, so keep your eyes peeled! 

Thank you for your patience and continued support

The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Mass Exodus v1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
 
We’ve been hard at work, adding features and fixing Mass Exodus based on the community’s feedback, and are happy to update the game today with lots of neat additions!
 
We would like to thank everyone who informed us about these problems and made suggestions. 
 
We look forward to hearing what you think of the new additions!
 
[b][h1]New![/h1][/b][list]
[*]VR Navigation: You no longer need to use the PC to join or create games, everything can be done in VR through the new hub room
[*]The VR player will now have a guide for the power ups on their left controller in the main menu
[*]You can now save game settings if they’ve been adjusted for custom games, making it quicker to have rematches
[*]Moving robots to another platform now teleports them back to where they were originally, which stops the Seeker from just moving everyone away from a control panel
[*]The Scanner power for the seeker now changes colour depending on distance from the Rogue (Red / Far > Green / Close)
[*]UI prompts have been added to floating blue cogs when you walk through them, to show you if you can collect them or not
[*]New Oculus controller models have been added for Oculus users
[*]Vive controller model has received updates
[*]VR Players can now press the Menu button on the VIVE or the Oculus will bring up the controls for the game
[*]PC players can now press ‘SPACE’ on PC, ‘BACK’ on xbox controllers or ‘SHARE’ on Playstation controllers while in game for a help screen popup
[*]Added a “controls” screen in the ready up area
[*]You can now use the grip buttons as well as the triggers to pick up androids as a Seeker
[*]Added a new way to grab robots as the seeker, using a small sphere as a guide you can pick out the rogue amongst a crowd much easier
[*]Added controls help to the Ready Up screen
[*]Region selection menu to improve online connection
[/list]


[b][h1]Fixes[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Invisibility no longer shows the rogue player as black instead of transparent
[*]Camera / player no longer moves while typing in the chat box or while paused
[*]Adjusted distance required to activate control panels, which should now be easier to activate
[*]Scanner now recharges if the setting is enabled in custom game settings
[*]Screen resolution should now scale correctly
[*]You can no longer move upwards through the ceiling as the Seeker on The Boiler Room map
[*]The mini-map for PC players will now show at the start of the game on The Core level
[*]You no longer have to “ready up” the VR person last to start the game
[*]Fixed an issue on the Boiler Room where the Seeker’s hand would disappear 
[/list]

We’re currently working on an exiting new project which we can reveal soon, but we will keep a keen eye on the Mass Exodus forums to see what needs adding or changing. We are aware of a couple bugs regarding multi-player which we are still working on.
 
If you have time to, leaving a review on our store page helps us massively.
 
Thanks to everyone that has supported us so far.

[b]The Polymerse Team[/b]

notes.title: Mass Exodus v0.1 The Boiler Room
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118244/143c401f123360a5718647633bfa6b63db1d3a0f.png[/img]

Hello Everyone!

The Boiler Room is ready to be pushed out of beta and into the main game! 

Now enjoy up to five player local multiplayer mode on both Assembly Line and the Boiler Room (4 pc vs 1 VR). In addition, we have adapted the amount of starting power ups depending on the amount of PC players. The second map is considerably larger than the first map and this is where we recommend 1 v 4 games, however it will remain balanced depending on the number of players. 

For this update we’ve also added custom gameplay settings which will allow you to change the game parameters to adjust to your specific play styles, including the ability to pick up power-ups around the map once you’ve used them.

Future updates will bring online multiplayer to the game which will allow non VR owners to play against, and with VR players,  as well as additional maps and VR vs VR game-modes.

Thank you for supporting Mass Exodus,
Let us know if you have any feedback!

The Polymerse Team

- Added outline to show which robot will be picked up

notes.title: Coming Soon - You asked, we deliver!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we hope you're enjoying the game so far!

We've been pushing small updates throughout the development of the game, but we thought it's about time for something big. This among other things will be added to the game soon!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118244/a88436f5db3f866e1795881b630bf426110b0931.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118244/7f03ab662fa0cd88a7de955bf8a38b90e462610f.png[/img]

[u][b]Introducing The Boiler Room![/b][/u]

This is a large scale map, designed for more players, which is now possible due to controller support! You will be able to play [b]1 vs up to 4 players[/b] in this level, and the original one shipped with the game!

As more real players are added, more control panels are required to destroy the seeker and less robots roam the factory! 

Also as requested, when any of your powerups are gone, you can explore the level and refill one by collecting a blue holographic cog!

We have a lot in store, and we can't wait to share it with you.
Have fun and Good Luck escaping The Boiler Room!

[u][b]The map, controller support and 1v4 support has now all been added to the public beta build.[/b][/u]


[u][b]Level customisation has now been added to the beta![/b][/u]
To find this, before you hit start game on the level selection screen hit "Game Settings".

Thanks
The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Mass Exodus v0.02.1
notes.notes:
Here’s the second small update of many!

Bug Fixes!
- Fixed an issue where the PC player’s mini-map disappeared
- Fixed an issue where the Game Over screen wouldn't display
- Replaced some models for slight performance increase
- General Optimisation

New!
- Added Height adjustment, use the right motion controller - up and down to adjust your height
- Added Player rotation, use the right motion controller - left and right to spin 90 degrees, great for players with small space
- Added Occlusion Culling to increase performance

-Opt in for the Unstable client, help test the game!.
(Right click Mass Exodus, Properties, Betas, Opt in)

Coming Soon!
- Render-scale / Supersampling
- Gamepad support
- New Oculus touch models
